what: the G2 case built one order short (blend continuity g1): it must read G1, not G2
method: profile: lines (20,10)-(20,20)-(0,20)-(0,0)-(10,0) closed by sketch.blend_curve g1 from (10,0) to (20,10), extruded 10. The blend is one Bezier of degree 3 matching each line's derivatives through order 1 at its end; a line's derivatives past the first are 0, so the curve's derivatives 2..1 vanish there and its curvature: tangent, but its second derivative is not 0, so the curvature jumps (G1, not G2). The extrusion carries the profile's continuity to both vertical seams (x=10, y=0 and x=20, y=10). No closed-form volume: 7 faces.
